source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Class NP (PDF 75-76).

blocks.text: Class NP un masail ki category hai jin ka koi hal diya jaye to computer use jaldi check (verify) kar sakta hai. Yani in masail mein pesh kiye gaye hal ko jaanchna aasan hai, magar khud hal dhoondna mushkil aur zyada waqt lene wala ho sakta hai.

Misal: Sudoku puzzle hal karna. Sudoku mein 9 x 9 grid ko numbers se aise bhara jata hai ke har row (qataar), column (sutoon) aur har 3 x 3 sub grid (chhota khaana) mein 1 se 9 tak har digit theek ek dafa aaye. Sudoku grid kitab mein Figure 3.3 hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka text kehta hai “as shown in Figure 3.5”, magar Sudoku grid Figure 3.3 (“A simple Sudoku Puzzle”) ke naam se chhapa hai; is chapter mein Figure 3.5 koi nahi.

items: Verification is Easy (jaanchna aasan): agar koi aap ko mukammal Sudoku grid de to aap jaldi check kar sakte hain ke hal durust hai ya nahi. Bas dekhna hai ke har row, column aur 3 x 3 sub grid mein 1 se 9 tak sab numbers bina dohrae maujood hon.

Finding the Solution is Hard (hal dhoondna mushkil): Sudoku ko shuru se hal karna, khaas taur par bare ya zyada mushkil puzzles, mushkil aur waqt lene wala ho sakta hai. Hal ki zamanat dene wala koi saada aur tez tareeqa nahi, is liye hal dhoondna hamesha efficient nahi hota.

Non-deterministic Polynomial Time (NP ka poora naam): Class NP ke masail mein agar durust hal diya jaye to use jaldi jaancha ja sakta hai, magar bare masail mein woh hal dhoondne mein na-qabil-e-amal had tak lamba waqt lag sakta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab teesre point mein kehti hai ke NP masail durust hal diye jane par “solved quickly” ho jate hain; matlab yeh hai ke diya gaya hal jaldi verify (jaancha) ho jata hai. NP ki asal pehchan yahi hai: hal jaanchna tez, hal dhoondna mushkil ho sakta hai.

items: Checking a Solution (hal jaanchna): Sudoku hal durust hai ya nahi, yeh jaldi pata chal jata hai: har row, column aur subgrid dekhein ke sab mein 1 se 9 tak numbers bina dohrae hain. Yeh jaanch seedhi aur efficient hai.

blocks.text: Solving the Puzzle (puzzle hal karna): Sudoku ke numbers ki durust tarteeb dhoondna mushkil ho sakta hai. Bohat si mumkina tarteebein (configurations) hoti hain, aur durust tarteeb tak pohanchne ke liye kaafi trial and error (aazma kar ghalti sudharna) ya advanced algorithm chahiye hota hai.

items: NP: diya gaya hal jaldi jaancha ja sakta hai; hal dhoondna mushkil ho sakta hai (Sudoku).
